abort.single_instance_allowed: ViCare Extras is already configured. Only a single instance is possible.

user.description:
ViCare Extras adds read-only actions and sensors on top of the built-in Viessmann ViCare integration. It reuses the existing login, needs no credentials of its own and does not poll the Viessmann API.

The Viessmann ViCare integration must be set up and loaded.
user.title: ViCare Extras

get_event_history.description: Fetches the event history of an installation from the Viessmann cloud. Every page fetched is one API call that counts against the daily quota.

cursor.description: Continue a previous call with the next_cursor it returned.
cursor.name: Cursor

edited_by.description: Only events edited by this user or system (passed to the API as editedBy).
edited_by.name: Edited by

event_type.description: Only return these event types. A single type is filtered by the API, several types are filtered after the download.
event_type.name: Event type

gateway_serials.description: Gateway serial numbers for gateway-level events (passed to the API as gatewaySerials).
gateway_serials.name: Gateway serials

installation_id.description: Installation to query. Defaults to the first installation of the ViCare integration.
installation_id.name: Installation ID

last_n_days.description: How many days to look back.
last_n_days.name: Last n days

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch. Each page is one API call.
max_pages.name: Maximum pages

get_event_history.name: Get event history

get_features.description: Returns the raw feature objects of a ViCare device from the data the built-in integration has already fetched. Never causes an API call.

device_id.description: Device of the Viessmann ViCare integration. Defaults to the heating device.
device_id.name: Device

device_type.description: Viessmann device type, for example heating, tcu or roomControl.
device_type.name: Device type

full.description: Return the complete feature objects including commands and URIs instead of name, timestamp and properties.
full.name: Complete objects

prefix.description: Only return features whose name starts with this text.
prefix.name: Feature prefix

vicare_device_id.description: Viessmann device ID, for example 0 or RoomControl-1. Also finds devices the built-in integration does not set up.
vicare_device_id.name: ViCare device ID

get_features.name: Get features
